name: SipMate
description: SipMate is a social discovery app that helps people find others nearby who are up for a drink, coffee, or spontaneous real-life meetup. It is not a dating app.

coreInteraction.name: Cheers
coreInteraction.flow: A user sends Cheers. When interest is mutual, it becomes CHEERS and chat unlocks.

privacy: SipMate uses location for nearby discovery without publicly showing a user's precise position, and users can go invisible when they do not want to appear nearby.
